hero.headline: Discover local products through short videos.
hero.subheadline: Shopi is the social commerce feed where sellers post videos and photos of what they're selling — and you scroll, discover, and message them directly.

features.headline: Built so local sellers waste zero time getting started.

scroll.title: Scroll to discover, not search
scroll.body: Forget boring classified listings. Sellers post short videos, product demos, and photos. You discover them the same way you'd discover content — by scrolling.

message.title: Interested? Just message.
message.body: No carts. No checkout. No payment forms. When you find something you want, tap to chat with the seller directly and agree on your own terms.

local.title: Local products, finally discoverable
local.body: That farmer selling tomatoes in Kiambu. The sneaker dealer in Eastleigh. The tailor in Kisumu. They're all on Shopi — and now you can actually find them.

communities.title: Join communities that match you
communities.body: "iPhones in Embakasi." "Sneakers Kenya." "Farm Produce Nairobi." Join niche local communities where buyers and sellers already know each other.

postOnce.title: Post once. Reach thousands.
postOnce.body: One video can reach thousands of potential buyers in your city. No ad budget needed — just good content and the right community.

import.title: Already on TikTok? Just import it.
import.body: If you already post on TikTok or Instagram, bring your content straight to Shopi where it actually converts into sales.

howItWorks.headline: Discover locally. Connect directly. No checkout needed.

1.title: Sign up in 30 seconds
1.body: No credit card. No long forms. Pick your interests — phones, fashion, food, whatever — and your local feed is ready.

2.title: Scroll your local feed
2.body: Watch videos and photos posted by real sellers near you. Think TikTok, but every post is something actually for sale — with a seller you can message directly.

3.title: Like it? Message the seller.
3.body: Tap to open a direct chat with any seller. Negotiate, ask questions, arrange pickup or delivery — completely on your terms.

4.title: Sell. Post. Build your audience.
4.body: Sellers post content, grow followers, and build trust over time. The more you post, the more people discover what you're selling.

audience.headline: Everyone in Kenya buying and selling locally.

buyers.title: Stop searching. Start discovering.
buyers.body: Forget typing into a search bar hoping to find the right seller. On Shopi, your feed surfaces local products you'd actually want — based on your interests, your area, and what's trending near you.

sellers.title: Your phone is your storefront.
sellers.body: Post a 30-second video. Reach buyers in your city without spending on ads. Build a following that comes back every time you post something new. No website needed. No delivery company required.

testimonials.headline: Sellers across Kenya are already making it work.

download.headline: Your local market just got a social feed.
download.body: Shopi is available on iOS and Android. Download the app and join thousands of sellers and buyers already on the platform.

footer.tagline: The social commerce feed for Kenya.

support.agentSubtitle: Usually replies in a few minutes
support.greeting: Hi there 👋 I'm Amina from the Shopi support team. How can I help you today?
support.autoReply: Thanks for reaching out! Our team has received your message and will reply shortly.
